description: Logistics Readiness rules. A package is READY FOR CONSTRUCTION when its packing list is verified, its MDR is approved (or not required) and it has been received and inspected at site (RFS + inspection date). Weights produce the Readiness Index (0-100). Edit this file and re-run the ETL to change the logic; the web app, Excel and SQL views all use the computed PACKAGE_READINESS table.

gates.label: Packing List Verified
gates.rule: At least one Detail block linked to the Summary package and no open blocking (identity) issue.

gates.label: MDR Approved
gates.rule: Credit by MDR state (see mdr_credit). 'MDR not required' in MDR No./Remark counts as approved.

gates.label: Arrived on Site
gates.rule: Inspection record, site tag ('onsite') or a laydown/location remark.

gates.label: Received & Inspected (RFS)
gates.rule: RFS Material Receiving number AND inspection date present (RFS only = half credit).

statuses.label: Ready for Construction
statuses.rule: PL verified AND MDR credit = 1 AND received & inspected.

statuses.label: Inspected - MDR Pending
statuses.rule: Received & inspected but MDR not approved.
statuses.action: Expedite MDR approval with vendor / QA-QC before issue to construction.

statuses.label: On Site - Awaiting RFS / Inspection
statuses.rule: Site evidence (tag or location) but no RFS / inspection date.
statuses.action: Raise RFS and perform receiving inspection.

statuses.label: Shipped - In Transit (not yet on site)
statuses.rule: Listed in the final packing list; no site record yet.
statuses.action: Track delivery; prepare MDR so the package is ready on arrival.

statuses.label: Blocked - Packing List Issue
statuses.rule: Packing list not verified or an open blocking identity issue.
statuses.action: Resolve the packing-list identity issue (see MAPPING_ISSUES).
